Why this is allowed for moni
----------------------------
moni is a locally-run同业信源监测 / 事实核查工具. It is free to use, is not
resold, and is not a website-building or no-code animation authoring product
(the category GSAP's license reserves for Webflow). The GreenSock standard
license explicitly permits bundling the compiled distribution file
(`gsap.min.js`) inside websites, local applications and software
distributions, and requires only that the copyright and license notice be
retained — which the file header above does.

If moni is ever redistributed in a form that charges money, or becomes a
site-building product, this license must be re-reviewed against
https://gsap.com/standard-license/ before shipping.
